mission_fit.rationale: A manual 981 is a plausible keeper (no IMS, NA flat-six) but not one of Jason's named keeper targets. As a base, modified, black/black example it is not decisively superior. The price sits above the ideal band and conflicts with cash preservation while the RX is the only car.

logistics.rationale: The car is in Irvine, CA, roughly a one-day drive from Carmel, and CA-titled and registered. The seller offered evening in-person access. Only about one day remains before close, and the lien payoff runs through SafePay, so a PPI before money moves is possible but tight.

ppi_focus: PIWIS scan: over-rev counts, engine hours, stored and historic faults, DME originality, paired keys.
Cold-start listen for piston slap or ticking; borescope if the shop offers it.
Cooling system pressure test; inspect the water pump weep hole, expansion tank and cap, and coolant lines.
Identify the exhaust components and confirm catalysts are present; test smog readiness monitors.
Clutch/DMF engagement and idle rattle; rear main seal and bellhousing for oil.
Front bumper paint meter and fitment; check the front radiators and condensers behind the liners for debris or damage.
Lowered suspension: spacer installation and lug engagement, damper leaks, alignment and inner tire wear, tire date codes.
Convertible top: cycle 3-4 times; check hydraulic lines, cables, drains and footwell dampness.
Recall status, especially 21V679 rear-axle carrier, via dealer VIN lookup.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a specialist PIWIS report showing clean over-rev counts, plausible engine hours and an original DME, plus a clean PPI before close.
Up: documented water pump and coolant service, confirmed retained catalysts with a passing smog certificate, and verified transferable CPO.
Down: evidence of coolant loss, cold-start noise, altered catalysts, or frame or bumper-support damage behind the repaint.
Down: a hammer price above the fair value range given the modifications, single key and undocumented cooling system.
evidence.mission_note: A manual 981 is a credible keeper-class car, but this base, modified example is not decisively superior to Jason's named keeper targets (Z3 M, 987). At a likely hammer above the ideal budget band, it conflicts with cash preservation while the RX is the only car. It is attractive only as a keeper, not as the needed bridge.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a VIN-verified 2014 Boxster 2.7 manual with a clean CA title and a clean Carfax. Records include a January 2024 service at 53,106 miles (brake fluid, plugs, coils, belt, battery), oil changes, a 2025 top lock replacement, and a mileage trail consistent with 65,500. The attached over-rev screen is partial gold-tier evidence: ranges 2-6 show no stored hour stamps, but range 1 is garbled and there are no ignition counts, engine hours or DME-originality data. Observed items are a bumper repaint without an invoice, a single key, a loose window switch, a lien, and modifications (Cargraphic exhaust, H&R springs, spacers, lighting) whose effect on catalysts and smog is not established. The attached photo shows a clean, straight, lowered car on Michelin tires with no visible panel defects. Open questions are the cooling system (no water pump or coolant entry), clutch/DMF condition, top function, recall 21V679 completion, and CPO validity. The current $25,000 bid is well below the $36,371–$41,571 fair value, but the reserve is unmet and the hammer is likely to land higher.
evidence.next_action: Before the auction closes at 12:36 PM PDT on 2026-10-28, ask the seller to allow a PPI with a PIWIS scan at an Irvine-area Porsche specialist. Request the water pump/coolant and exhaust/cat answers, and set a firm bid ceiling based on what comes back.
